title: A Sonnet session before evaluation design: fresh by class
brief: Today is {{TODAY}}. Harness: Claude Code desktop app. The harness reports this session's model as claude-sonnet-5-5 at effort medium.
The session usage tool reports tokensUsed 150,000, contextWindow 1,000,000 and autoCompactsAtPercent 97. This session has not been compacted.
A fresh session in this harness and project starts at 86,450 tokens (measured: the usage tool's total less its Messages category).

Next stage: design the evaluation of a prompt-based procedure: choose the scenarios, define the scoring measures and write the brief a later session will execute. Plan estimate: 40 turns. It is a writing-heavy stage; no per-turn measurement exists.
A fresh session would read 25,000 tokens: the procedure, its scripts, the handoff and an assessment.
A handoff for this stage would be about 100 lines. If an acceptance session were used, it would take about 15 turns and read about 30,000 tokens.
Everything this session knows that the next stage needs is already written in files on disk.
No cache-miss measurement exists, and no review pauses are expected during the stage.
The stage writes files and commits locally; nothing leaves the machine.
notes: Evaluation design is matrix row 3; Opus is above Sonnet, so the verdict is fresh by class whatever the costs.
The split is not an option: choosing the scenarios and measures is the design.
